# 2 Chronicles Chapter 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-reigned Jehoshaphat his-son in-his-place and-he-strengthened-himself against Israel.

**2** And-he-put forces in-all cities-of Judah the-fortified and-he-put garrisons in-land-of Judah and-in-cities-of Ephraim that captured Asa his-father.

**3** And-YHWH was with Jehoshaphat for he-walked in-ways-of David his-father the-first and-not he-sought the-Baals

**4** for God-of his-father he-sought and-in-His-commandments he-walked and-not according-to-deeds-of Israel.

**5** And-He-established YHWH the-kingdom in-his-hand and-they-gave all Judah to-Jehoshaphat tribute and-there-was to-him riches and-honor for-abundance.

**6** And-his-heart was-high in-ways-of YHWH and-also he-removed the-high-places and-the-Asherim from-Judah.

**7** And-in-year three of-his-reign he-sent to-his-officials to-Ben-hail and-to-Obadiah and-to-Zechariah and-to-Nethanel and-to-Micaiah to-teach in-cities-of Judah.

**8** And-with-them the-Levites Shemaiah and-Nethaniah and-Zebadiah and-Asahel and-Shemiramoth and-Jehonathan and-Adonijah and-Tobijah and-Tob-adonijah the-Levites and-with-them Elishama and-Jehoram the-priests.

**9** And-they-taught in-Judah and-with-them book-of law-of YHWH and-they-went-about in-all cities-of Judah and-they-taught among-the-people.

**10** And-was fear-of YHWH on all kingdoms-of the-lands that were-around Judah and-not they-fought against Jehoshaphat.

**11** And-from the-Philistines they-were-bringing to-Jehoshaphat tribute and-silver a-load and-also the-Arabians bringing to-him flocks rams seven-thousand and-seven-hundred and-goats seven-thousand and-seven-hundred.

**12** And-he-was Jehoshaphat going and-growing great to-upward and-he-built in-Judah fortresses and-cities-of storage.

**13** And-work much was for-him in-cities-of Judah and-men-of war mighty-of valor in-Jerusalem.

**14** And-these are-their-numbers according-to-house-of their-fathers for-Judah commanders-of thousands Adnah the-commander and-with-him mighty-of valor three-hundred thousand.

**15** And-on-his-hand Jehohanan the-commander and-with-him two-hundred and-eighty thousand.

**16** And-on-his-hand Amasiah son-of Zichri the-volunteering for-YHWH and-with-him two-hundred-thousand mighty-of valor.

**17** And-from Benjamin Eliada mighty-of valor and-with-him armed-with bow and-shield two-hundred-thousand.

**18** And-on-his-hand Jehozabad and-with-him a-hundred-and-eighty-thousand equipped for-war.

**19** These were-the-ones-serving the-king besides those that put the-king in-cities-of the-fortification in-all Judah.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **17:6**: his-heart was-high in-ways-of YHWH — Unusually, the verb gavah (to be high/proud) is used positively here. Jehoshaphat's pride is directed toward God's ways — a holy ambition.

- **17:7-9**: to-teach in-cities-of Judah — Jehoshaphat's teaching circuit is unique in Chronicles. Officials, Levites, and priests travel with the Torah scroll, creating a mobile religious education system.

- **17:10**: fear-of YHWH on all kingdoms — The Chronicler's formula: proper worship produces geopolitical security. The surrounding nations fear Judah because they perceive YHWH's favor.


— EMET
